name: comfy-skills
description: Comfy skills and plugins for AI coding agents. Includes comfy-cloud, the Comfy Cloud MCP connection plus slash commands, and comfy-local, the stdio MCP connection to your own ComfyUI, both for Claude Code.

plugins.name: comfy-cloud
plugins.description: Comfy Cloud in Claude Code: the hosted MCP connection plus slash commands for generating images, video, audio, and 3D and searching the catalog.

plugins.name: comfy-local
plugins.description: Comfy local in Claude Code: the stdio MCP connection to your own ComfyUI (via comfy-cli) plus slash commands for generating images and video and searching your live templates, models, and nodes.
